summary: Current LOCAL candidate only: four reproduced issues, grouped by root cause. All 11 synthetic emulator tests passed, including negative controls. No current-live security conclusion; historical Firestore source was not recovered. No app/rules/cloud changes performed.

findings.check: Authority Source / Business Logic vs Rules
findings.issue: F1: An active ordinary user can directly change their own avatarUrl to an external HTTPS image URL; another user can read the URL. Firestore enforces only string type/length, so the canonical Storage upload and Vision pre-scan are bypassable. Client image widgets automatically render avatarUrl. This proves an unscanned image-source bypass, not server-side request forgery or script execution.
findings.precondition: Authenticated active user with a valid own profile; no moderator privilege needed.
findings.recommendation: Make published avatar identity server-controlled and tied to a successfully moderated canonical object; preserve a reviewed legacy migration path.

findings.issue: F2: blockedUsers is stored inside the publicly readable version-2 profile. An unrelated authenticated user can enumerate version-2 profiles (limit <=50 per query) and read each block relationship; the blocked user can point-read the list too. Friendship lists remain protected; this is specifically disclosure of the blocklist field.
findings.precondition: Authenticated account; target profileVersion=2 and nonempty blockedUsers.
findings.recommendation: Move block relationships into a separately protected document/collection and adapt rule lookups and atomic block operations.

findings.check: Business Logic vs Rules / Resource Exhaustion
findings.issue: F3: Notification document IDs and cardinality are not enforced server-side. Even with abuse policy enabled, a verified match owner created five identical profile invitations under different IDs; one follow-request cooldown permit authorized five notices in a single batch; an existing pending roster slot authorized three new formation notices without any match mutation. This bypasses client deduplication and enables inbox spam and additional document/listener costs. No unlimited-throughput claim is made.
findings.precondition: Authenticated active sender; verified email when runtime abuse policy enabled; valid profile pair, owned future match or pending invitation as appropriate.
findings.recommendation: Enforce deterministic notification identity and one notice per validated event, or create notifications in a trusted idempotent transaction with bounded resend policy.

findings.issue: F4: A match owner can change maxPlayers from14 to10 while12 members remain because a metadata-only owner update skips validRoster. An innocent participant's leave update then fails since11 remaining members still exceed10. Restoring capacity14 makes the same leave operation succeed. This is a roster-integrity/availability defect affecting participants, not ownership escalation.
findings.precondition: Authenticated active owner of a valid populated match.
findings.recommendation: Revalidate roster invariants whenever maxPlayers changes, including member count and valid slot keys.

historicalEvidence.scope: Historical deployed Storage source only; not current-live confirmation and excluded from candidate score.
historicalEvidence.reconstruction: Historical functions/rules/storage.candidate.rules blob normalized to CRLF exactly matches saved release metadata SHA256 and length.
historicalEvidence.issue: Owner upload of synthetic non-image bytes with declared image/jpeg succeeds and another authenticated user reads the exact bytes. Rules check metadata MIME and size but do not require a pre-scan. Emulator did not run Vision/storage triggers; this does not prove a Vision classification outcome, long-term persistence, public token URL access, or code execution.
historicalEvidence.currentCandidate: Owner create/update and metadata alteration are denied in current candidate Storage; F1 remains a separate Firestore avatar source bypass.

negativeControls: One-sided friendship cannot list another user's friends
Actual atomic block-and-friend-deletion revokes friend-list access
Unverified formation invite denied under enabled abuse policy
Candidate Storage owner upload/metadata update and foreign delete denied
Unauthenticated candidate Storage SDK read denied

validation.note: Initial harness run failed due to repeated context.firestore() initialization; corrected in independent harness before the successful run. Application sources unchanged.
